meta.probingQuestion: What breaks in you when a connection breaks?

games.title: Guard Recovery After Leg Pass Game

meta.connection: Losing the pin and getting reversed is a small rupture. How you handle that break on the mat, a clean reset or payback, is a lot like how you handle broken connections in life.
meta.takeaway: Tonight you worked from a single leg, side control, and a figure-four pin. Losing a pin and getting reversed is a small break, and how you respond, a clean reset or payback, is a real choice. That same choice shows up when a connection breaks with someone in life. You get to choose the reset over the payback.

body.text: Guard Recovery After Leg Pass Game

items: The bottom player wins by getting his legs back in front in any real guard.
The top player wins by locking his hands around the bottom player.
